statement: The exact exceptional normal-bundle polynomial controls a blow-up middle radical; ample pencil bases give a candidate criterion while all linear stabilized quintic blow-ups satisfy B
depends_on: C.1j; Jiang2023 Eq2.2 and Theorem2.8(3); projective-bundle formula; weak Lefschetz
notes: Controlling center degree is at or below its middle. A smooth base of an ample pencil in a Tate ambient would refute universal B precisely if its middle Griffiths group were nonzero; no such class is constructed. The apparent stabilized quintic kernel lies on the nonample boundary. Method-limit and criterion only; no main-gate closure.

statement: Numerical equals homological in codimensions0/1/2/n−1/n over C and the degree-two homological Lefschetz cokernel is its exact complementary numerical radical
depends_on: Kleiman1968 Remarks3.4 and3.10 pp379-380; Hodge index; Hodge-Riemann; hard Lefschetz and rational Lefschetz1-1
notes: Full D holds on every complex fourfold. First uncovered pair is codim3 on a fivefold; that radical is not proved zero. The all-source endpoint criterion of C1n remains undecided. Classical cases and a precise quotient; no new universal-gate closure asserted.
